mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_course_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler} AND package_id = #{packageId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}

SELECT * FROM user_course_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler} AND course_id = #{courseId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_course_progress (id, user_id, course_id, package_id, status, progress_percent, last_position, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{userId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{courseId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{packageId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{status}, #{progressPercent}, #{lastPosition}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_course_progress SET progress_percent = #{progressPercent}, last_position = #{lastPosition}, status = CASE WHEN #{progressPercent} > 0 AND status = 'NOT_STARTED' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE status END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler} AND course_id = #{courseId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}

UPDATE user_course_progress SET status = 'COMPLETED', progress_percent = 100, completed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler} AND course_id = #{courseId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_course_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler} AND package_id = #{packageId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler} AND status = 'COMPLETED'
